title: Eric's portrait: shoulder no longer cut straight
question: Should the game use the wider cut, where his shoulder and arm end inside the picture?

media.caption: In the game at 2560x1440, zoomed 2x on his left shoulder (image right). Before: the blazer ends in a straight vertical line. After: the arm curves and closes with its outline.
2560x1440, neutral, before and after. His face, size and chin height are the same.
1366x860, neutral. At this size his arm already runs off the right screen edge, before and after, so nothing changes here.

Phone 390x844, neutral. The picture still runs past the right screen edge (its right side is at 438 px on a 390 px screen); the re-cut can't change that, because the phone layout places his face at 80% of the screen width. The page doesn't scroll sideways.
The three game files now (597x768) on dark, light and a checkerboard.
The three new files (648x768). The red tick at the top marks where the old picture ended.
The new strip at 2x over a checkerboard: the matte is clean and the outline is closed.

tools/imgqa.py on the new files: all pass (red rim 0 to 0.1%, glasses cover 1.00, matte frame 0.01 to 0.03, headroom 7%). imgqa still assumes the old 597 px width, so its face-similarity number is lower than it should be; a direct pixel check shows the face area differs from today's files by 0.4 of 255 on average (webp re-encoding only).

options.label: eric-canvas-648: wider cut
options.note: No outpaint or new render was needed: the approved render r4-909 already has his whole arm, and the game crop stopped at source x 735. This is the same crop (scale 1.051125 from source x 167.30, y -47.35) taken 51 px wider, 648x768 instead of 597x768. Only the new strip x 597 to 647 is added to each approved file; the rest, face and expressions included, is today's pixels. The arm ends at x 626. In the game only FACE.eric's width changes (597 to 648); its face box [112,208,348,399] stays.
